title: First In, Last Out
author: favarazz
rules:
This is my first set puzzle, so I'd love any feedback, good or bad (but be kind). While solving Meggen033's Fogcestershire, I thought it would be a neat twist if the first clues you can use to place digits were the last ones to be fully resolved. This puzzle doesn't quite get there yet. The clues in the starting area aren't the very last thing you finish, but they're among the final steps.

Rules:
• Place the digits 1 to 9 once each in every row, column and 3×3 box.

• Anti-knight: Cells a chess knight's move apart can't contain the same digit.

• Killer cages: Digits in a cage don't repeat and sum to the small clue in the cage's corner.

• German whispers: Neighboring digits on a green line differ by at least 5.

• Fog of war: The grid is covered in fog. Placing a correct digit clears the fog in that cell and the eight cells around it, revealing any clues underneath.

solutionCode: Row 1 (left to right), then column 9 (top to bottom). 18 digits, no spaces.
